propositions: A Jira parent removed/cleared is never reflected in local parent_id because the snapshot omits the parent field when it is absent and the differ refuses to emit parent_id=None
The fetcher drops the signal at layer 1 by leaving the parent field absent when get_parent_map returns None, conflating an observed-absent parent with an unqueried/unobserved parent

The differ drops the signal at layer 2 by refusing to emit parent_id=None to avoid accidentally clearing a locally-set parent when the peer parent key cannot yet be resolved, but this same guard blocks clearing when the peer genuinely has no parent

A parent clear must be emitted only on positive evidence that the peer once had this parent, not on managed_refs alone, because managed_refs means the ref was set locally but does not prove it was ever pushed to the peer

The ADR-0026 per-binding record (baseline) is the evidence channel: set_peer_parent on the binding entry when a pass observes the parent key, emit the clear only when get_peer_parent is truthy and the peer now has no parent
The same-pass outbound-to-inbound suppression via _OUTBOUND_TO_INBOUND_FIELD must be pinned by test because it is the second protection against clearing a locally-set parent in a healthy pass
